scope: Independent source/diff/fixture review only; no tests, analyzer, RPC, services or production state actions

static_evidence_conclusions.conclusion: New exclusive directory is reserved before version/analyzer/checker work. Existing requested directories fail without analysis. Default mktemp directories are unique; old production files are untouched.

Both analyzer and tee statuses are captured before subsequent shell commands. Only analyzer0/255 proceeds; capture failure aborts. Final checker pipeline retains pipefail, so either checker rejection or final tee failure prevents success.

Shared strict UTF8 object reads reject duplicate/nonfinite/ambiguous data. Bad findings identities and unexpected source names cannot reach unchecked formatting/path echoes. Existing review inventory/fingerprint/scope gates remain.
Old review source mismatch is not waived. These orchestration tests do not run current Slither or close the19changed historical pins, compiler or independent audit gate.
Upload path follows the newly reserved reports/slither.*/ directories and uses if:always. Upload existence alone is not a green checker/analyzer result.

findings.description: Ordinary Python literal containing Unicode escape u0073 is decoded by Python before JSON parsing. That subcase currently repeats a literal duplicate key rather than exercising an escaped-equivalent JSON key. Shared strict-parser correctness is not challenged by this observation.
findings.recommendation: Use a raw string or doubled backslash if describing this subcase as escaped-equivalent-key evidence.
findings.status: Reported to root; root owns edit and evidence

backend_chronology_cross_review.conclusion: No blocking safety/liveness regression found in inspected diff/context/tests. Target timestamp validates exact nonboolean SQLite-safe integer; first header validates integer/nonnegative and target upper bound; the existing adjacency query now checks every later timestamp and rejects regression while allowing equal L2 timestamps. All header validation precedes log iteration/consumer, including eventless and filtered blocks.
backend_chronology_cross_review.cost: Extends the existing ancestry query; no new network call, extra query or DB write. Query remains within read snapshot/progress-handler/deadline and supplied bounds.
backend_chronology_cross_review.limitations: This is source review, not independent execution, database authentication, full history proof or release qualification.
